title: Our American Cousin
author: Tom Taylor
description: "Our American Cousin" by Tom Taylor is a three-act play that premiered in 1858.
longDescription: When boorish American Asa Trenchard travels to England to claim his family's estate, he clashes hilariously with his aristocratic English relatives.

authorInfo.bio: Tom Taylor (1817–1880) wrote Our American Cousin. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
